entities.name: Lawrence of Březová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lawrence of Březová was a Czech writer of Hussite period, author of Carmen insignis Corone Bohemie and Historia Hussitica. He wrote in Czech and Latin. He was a historian of the Hussite movement. His works are usually regarded as more or less reliable.
